gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE l.days_past_due > 30) / NULLIF(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt), 0), 2) AS par30 FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = l.branch_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio GROUP BY b.branch_name
SELECT loan_number, total_outstanding_mnt FROM t2s.loans ORDER BY total_outstanding_mnt DESC LIMIT 5

question_mn: Өнөөдрийн байдлаар 90-ээс дээш хоног хэтэрсэн зээл хэд вэ?

question_en: How many loans are more than 90 days past due as of today?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio AND days_past_due > 90 AND disbursement_date < CURRENT_DATE
